## JC
```{r}
# Find indices of individuals with '_JC' in their names
jc_indices <- grep("_JC", adegenet::indNames(my_genlight))

# Subset the genlight object
jc_genlight <- my_genlight[jc_indices, ]

# Compute allele frequency for the subsetted JC individuals
af_jc <- adegenet::glMean(jc_genlight)

# Convert the numeric vector to a data frame for ggplot
sfs_data <- data.frame(AF = af_jc)
sfs_data$MAF <- ifelse(sfs_data$AF > 0.5, 1 - sfs_data$AF, sfs_data$AF)
# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(sfs_data, aes(x = MAF)) + 
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(count / sum(count))), # Converts y-axis to proportions
    bins = 40, 
    fill = "steelblue", 
    color = "white", 
    boundary = 0
  ) + 
    theme_classic() + # Cleans up background gridlines
    scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.01, 0.5), 
    breaks = seq(0.01, 0.5, by = 0.1), 
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(
    title = "JC Site Frequency Spectrum (SFS)",
    subtitle = "bins by 40; 66,834 loci",
    x = "Allele Frequency",
    y = "Proportion of Loci"                 # Updated axis label
  ) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )
plot 

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(photo_path, "jc_afs_all_loci.png"), 
  plot = plot,
    width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## JA
```{r}
# Find indices of individuals with '_JC' in their names
jc_indices <- grep("_JC", adegenet::indNames(my_genlight))

# Subset the genlight object
jc_genlight <- my_genlight[jc_indices, ]

# Compute allele frequency for the subsetted JC individuals
af_jc <- adegenet::glMean(jc_genlight)

# Convert the numeric vector to a data frame for ggplot
sfs_data <- data.frame(AF = af_jc) %>% mutate(Species = "JC")

# Find indices of individuals with '_JC' in their names
ja_indices <- grep("_JA", adegenet::indNames(my_genlight))

# Subset the genlight object
ja_genlight <- my_genlight[ja_indices, ]

# Compute allele frequency for the subsetted JC individuals
af_ja <- adegenet::glMean(ja_genlight)

# Convert the numeric vector to a data frame for ggplot
sfs_data_ja <- data.frame(AF = af_ja) %>% mutate(Species = "JA")
sfs_data <- sfs_data %>% rows_append(sfs_data_ja)

sfs_data$MAF <- ifelse(sfs_data$AF > 0.5, 1 - sfs_data$AF, sfs_data$AF)

plot <- ggplot(sfs_data, aes(x = MAF, fill = Species)) + 
  geom_histogram(
    # Correctly calculates proportions within each individual species group
    aes(y = after_stat(count / tapply(count, group, sum)[group])), 
    bins = 40, 
    color = "white", 
    boundary = 0,
    position = "identity", 
    alpha = 0.5            
  ) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(
    title = "Folded Site Frequency Spectrum (SFS)", 
    subtitle = "bins by 40; 66,834 loci", 
    x = "Minor Allele Frequency (MAF)", 
    y = "Proportion of Loci within Species",
    fill = "Species"
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.5), 
    breaks = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.1), 
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(photo_path, "ja_afs_all_loci.png"), 
  plot = plot,
      width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## JC, by ind
```{r}
# Identify JC individuals
jc_indices <- grep("_JC", indNames(my_genlight))

# Subset genlight object
jc_genlight <- my_genlight[jc_indices, ]

# Extract genotype matrix
geno <- as.matrix(jc_genlight)

# Convert to allele frequency
geno_freq <- geno / 2

# Calculate population AF for each locus
population_af <- colMeans(geno_freq, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create bins matching the original 40-bin histogram
breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 41)

# Assign each locus to a bin
bin_id <- cut(
  population_af,
  breaks = breaks,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = FALSE
)

# Calculate individual contributions per bin
hist_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(geno_freq)), function(i) {

  # Count individual genotype contributions by population AF bin
  counts <- tabulate(
    bin_id[!is.na(geno_freq[i, ]) & !is.na(bin_id)],
    nbins = 40
  )

  data.frame(
    Individual = indNames(jc_genlight)[i],
    Bin = seq_len(40),
    Count = counts
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Calculate bin midpoints
hist_data <- hist_data %>%
  mutate(
    AF = (breaks[Bin] + breaks[Bin + 1]) / 2
  )

folded_hist_data <- hist_data %>%
  mutate(
    AF = (breaks[Bin] + breaks[Bin + 1]) / 2,
    MAF = ifelse(AF > 0.5, 1 - AF, AF)
  ) %>%
  # Group by the folded MAF and Individual to sum their locus counts/proportions
  group_by(MAF, Individual) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(`Count`), .groups = "drop") %>% # Use your actual column name if different
  # Calculate relative proportions across the entire folded spectrum
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count))

main_plot <- ggplot(folded_hist_data, aes(x = MAF, y = Proportion, fill = Individual)) + 
  geom_col(
    width = 1/40,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white" # Clean border between stacked segments
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "JC Population SFS by Individual Contribution",
    x = "Population Allele Frequency",
    y = "Locus Count",
    fill = "Individual"
  )

# Extract legend
plot_legend <- get_legend(main_plot)

# Remove legend
main_plot_no_legend <- main_plot +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Display
main_plot_no_legend

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(photo_path, "jc_afs_by_individual.png"),
  plot = main_plot_no_legend,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(photo_path, "jc_ind_legend.png"), 
  plot = ggdraw(plot_legend)
)
```


## JA, by ind
```{r}
# Identify JC individuals
indices <- grep("_JA", indNames(my_genlight))

# Subset genlight object
genlight <- my_genlight[indices, ]

# Extract genotype matrix
geno <- as.matrix(genlight)

# Convert to allele frequency
geno_freq <- geno / 2

# Calculate population AF for each locus
population_af <- colMeans(geno_freq, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create bins matching the original 40-bin histogram
breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 41)

# Assign each locus to a bin
bin_id <- cut(
  population_af,
  breaks = breaks,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = FALSE
)

# Calculate individual contributions per bin
hist_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(geno_freq)), function(i) {

  # Count individual genotype contributions by population AF bin
  counts <- tabulate(
    bin_id[!is.na(geno_freq[i, ]) & !is.na(bin_id)],
    nbins = 40
  )

  data.frame(
    Individual = indNames(jc_genlight)[i],
    Bin = seq_len(40),
    Count = counts
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Calculate bin midpoints
hist_data <- hist_data %>%
  mutate(
    AF = (breaks[Bin] + breaks[Bin + 1]) / 2
  )

main_plot <- ggplot(
  hist_data,
  aes(x = AF, y = Count, fill = Individual)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 1 / 40,
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "JA Population SFS by Individual Contribution",

    y = "Locus Count",
    fill = "Individual"

  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(photo_path, "ja_ind_legend.png"), 
  plot = ggdraw(plot_legend)
)
```

```{r}
    geom_histogram(
```
